cases.title: Comp 1: a child with no keys rides a null moved by expressions; the answer names the parent, its expressions, and puts steps on the parent

checks.detail: no step on Shake Control (steps are on Shake Control, (none))

rubric.reason: One answer with source bullets, four steps and a single closing offer naming only *Set the pivot* (a step tag) that ends on a question; no greeting, recap or praise, and at 155 words it is only just over the 150-word line, not well past it.
It opens with "rock.png rides on Shake Control, a null moved by expressions," names the Position and Rotation expressions, and every step's layer is Shake Control, not the child.

"The turn centers on Shake Control, which sits at the middle of the comp" is stated as plain fact, but the reads never returned the comp's size or Shake Control's anchor point (only Position base [960,540]), so this inference should have been marked.
Four steps, each starting with an action (Open, Open, Select…drag, Play) on Shake Control or the playback, and ordered by the read amounts with Position (12.15 px) before Rotation (9.36 px).

Steps 1 and 2 only open and look at the expressions, say what the read shows ("uses the middle value for all three hits", "up to about 0.6°"), give no new values or code, and end with "Not something I teach yet."
